lede: The week's most consequential moment comes Tuesday when Telluride Town Council takes up third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — a vote that would amend the Land Use Code's historic review standards and landscaping rules to meet state wildfire mitigation requirements, the kind of quiet code change that affects what property owners can do on their own land. The intergovernmental worksession Monday gathers all five regional jurisdictions for a large-projects update, and the county Planning Commission meets Thursday to work through subdivision mechanics and a building energy code update. In between, the Jazz Festival and Ridgway Rendezvous are wrapping up the summer festival stretch.

notable.stake: Final vote on wildfire code that rewrites landscaping and historic review rules.
Commission weighs energy code and subdivision rules shaping all new county construction.
